verdict.rationale: Docs mention that installing the 'MemFS Search mod' enables keyword search and optional semantic or hybrid search, showing some support for alternate retrieval modes beyond plain similarity search. However, there is no evidence of native metadata filtering or reranking controls, and hybrid/keyword search is gated behind an optional add-on rather than being a first-class, built-in retrieval option. missing for 10: metadata filter support, reranking capability, evidence that hybrid/keyword search is core (not an optional mod), independent confirmation of retrieval quality.
